title: Plans to Support Workers in Economic Slowdown and Effectiveness of Past Plans
what_it_is: Plans to Support Workers in Economic Slowdown and Effectiveness of Past Plans

sections.label: Managing excess manpower in crisis
sections.summary: Government schemes like Jobs Credit and SPUR led most companies to postpone or reduce retrenchments, and resident unemployment stayed below 5% during the Global Financial Crisis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Measures taken then helped companies to manage excess manpower and to invest in skills for the recovery.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In a Ministry of Manpower (MOM) survey carried out in 2009, three in four companies with earlier plans to retrench workers reported they would postpone or reduce the number of affected workers due to Government assistance schemes, such as Jobs Credit and the Skills Programme for Upgrading and Resilience (SPUR).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Helped by improving external conditions, resident unemployment rate rose but did not exceed 5% throughout the Global Financial Crisis.

sections.label: Second quarter 2019 retrenchments
sections.summary: Retrenchments in the second quarter of 2019 remained fairly low at 2,300.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: If we look at the second quarter of 2019, retrenchments remained fairly low at 2,300.

sections.label: Monitoring economy and labour market
sections.summary: MOM, MTI and other agencies are monitoring the economy and labour market closely and are ready to step up support under Adapt and Grow.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: MOM, together with the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) and other Government agencies, is monitoring the economy and the labour market closely.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We are ready to step up support for companies and workers under the Adapt and Grow initiative.

sections.label: Reducing services dependency ratio ceiling
sections.summary: The services sector dependency ratio ceiling will be reduced in two steps, beginning January 2020 and January 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In fact, in the services sector, the dependency ratio ceiling will be reduced downwards.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We actually had quite a lively debate about whether those measures were appropriate.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We agreed that we would go ahead with two moves – one beginning in January 2020 and then another step coming in January 2021.

sections.label: Support measures for older workers
sections.summary: Support measures for older workers include the Special Employment Credit and programmes such as job redesign that help companies retain them.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Mr Desmond Choo also asked about older workers.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: There have been a lot of support measures put in place for older workers, including the Special Employment Credit as well as many programmes, such as job redesign, that help companies to retain their older workers, help them to stay productive and able to contribute.
